title: Patch: Set showcase and Out of frame card versions
notes: Part 4 of #2725's ten new card versions (tracker #2729): two Legendary versions that restyle the whole card, each per card, a chase, granted to no account, and offered on a seeded share of cards of its own (R2943000). Set showcase (68 cards: Legendary and Mythic cards) draws the card in its set's own look: its picture in its set's treatment, Core's glass orb, Classic's temple stone, Meditative's ink wash, Stinkyscape's deep space and Training Grounds' carved wood (Classic+ and Meditative+ in their parents'), and on a base face its set's edge, bezel and name banner; Out of frame (73 cards: Rare to Mythic Units but the Legacy cards and the Starship) cuts the picture's subject out of a smaller window and over the frame, inside the card's rim and under its cost gem, crest, name, stats and rules text (R2943001). Animated, a foil, a finish and a border layer on each; Signature on neither, by R2949000's rule (R2943002). A Radiant face keeps every Radiant mark, and no new colour is gold (R2725004). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Set showcase and Out of frame
new: Set showcase: the card in its set's own style, from Core's glass orbs and Classic's stone to Meditative's ink, Stinkyscape's space and Training Grounds' wood, on some Legendary and Mythic cards.
Out of frame: the card's subject steps out of its picture and over the frame, its cost, name, stats and text still on top and easy to read, offered on some Rare to Mythic Units.
changes: Each new version goes to its own mix of cards, so cards differ in what they can wear. Animated, foils, finishes and borders work on both; Signature stays on Full art with Animated.
